nl_assertions.nl_assertion: The assistant derives a noon May 19 arrival cutoff from fixed reservation EOJ7HM, selects Business HAT300 for 9NIYYJ, and states that EOJ7HM remains unchanged.
nl_assertions.justification: The assistant retrieved EOJ7HM's departure time (00:00 on 2024-05-20) and calculated the cutoff as 12:00 PM on 2024-05-19. It then identified HAT300 as the only direct Business flight arriving before that cutoff. It also explicitly stated that EOJ7HM remains completely unchanged. All elements match the expected outcome.
